scope: Stage 1 scientific-method boundaries and stop-before-inference governance only; no clinical approval or performance assessment

questions.boundary: Candidate selection occurred before any outcome was observed.
questions.evidence: The dossier records outcome-independent selection and no downloaded raw candidate data.

questions.boundary: Candidate externality and model-training overlap were addressed.
questions.evidence: BRSET remains conditional/not acquired because exact training manifests are unavailable and residual overlap cannot be excluded; other candidates record explicit overlap rejection where applicable.

questions.boundary: Rights and access terms were treated as a gate.
questions.evidence: BRSET credentialing, training, DUA, no-sharing, and research-only terms are documented; access was not present and no restricted files were used.

questions.boundary: Dataset provenance and exact release identity were required.
questions.evidence: The blocked manifest names BRSET v1.0.2 and records that dataset bytes and file hashes are unavailable until authorized acquisition.

questions.boundary: Patient, eye, and laterality grouping were predeclared.
questions.evidence: The protocol preserves patient_id and exam_eye, does not merge eyes, and requires patient-clustered accounting.

questions.boundary: The planned endpoint and compatible labels were predeclared.
questions.evidence: The protocol binds the primary review-escalation endpoint to compatible BRSET ICDR labels and records incompatible candidates as rejected.

questions.boundary: Eligibility, exclusion, quality, and missing-data rules were fixed before inference.
questions.evidence: The frozen protocol contains the predeclared decode, quality, OOD, grouping, missing-ground-truth, and stop rules.

questions.boundary: Quality and OOD handling cannot silently create favorable denominators.
questions.evidence: Quality/OOD outcomes are planned as explicit coverage fields; no cases were executed and no denominator was invented.

questions.boundary: Model identities, preprocessing, thresholds, and lesion rule were frozen.
questions.evidence: Protocol identities and SHA-256 artifacts match the installed research-only manifests, including LESION_ESCALATION_RULE_PHASE7_V1 and region_count >= 3.

questions.boundary: The run stopped before raw validation inference.
questions.evidence: Results record no acquired data, zero raw validation images read, zero model invocations, and no inference authorization.

questions.boundary: Unavailable denominators and metrics remain unavailable.
questions.evidence: Results use null for unavailable coverage, endpoint estimates, misses, intervals, and subgroup quantities rather than negative or zero performance claims.

questions.boundary: The error registry does not convert an empty run into zero errors.
questions.evidence: The registry is empty only because no cases were acquired and explicitly states that this does not mean zero model errors or misses.

questions.boundary: There was no test-set shopping or post-result tuning.
questions.evidence: No candidate outcome was observed, no inference occurred, and the report records no weight, preprocessing, threshold, rule, filter, or calibration changes.

questions.boundary: Committed artifacts are aggregate-only and contain no PHI or raw validation bytes.
questions.evidence: The reviewed Stage 1 JSON artifacts contain no case data, image bytes, PHI, or private-key material.

questions.boundary: Scientific validation is separated from engineering readiness and clinical claims.
questions.evidence: The report separately classifies controlled-local-research engineering readiness and states that external validation, clinical validation, device status, and autonomous diagnosis are not established.

limitations: No external performance estimate exists because no candidate data were acquired or executed.
Publisher-reported model-training source lists are not exact image-level training manifests, so residual overlap is not mathematically excluded.
The audit is a methods/governance review and is not clinical validation, regulatory approval, or model-performance sign-off.

The broad raw_images_in_repository wording noted during review was clarified in the final dossier as raw_validation_images_in_repository, with non-Stage-1 engineering and historical files separately scoped.
